test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 11 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six girls P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting in a straight line facing the North. P is second from the left end. R is to the immediate left of T. Only Q is between S and R. Who is sitting at the left end?
solution:
**Six Girls: **P, Q, R, S, T and U 

1) P is second from the left end.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48f2a844ea471dc74ee434eb8467b74e2180ec0b956fcd1c43b7412484962cbd.png] 

2) R is to the immediate left of T.

(T is to be sit at the extreme right end because only that condition 3 will be satisfied)

3) Only Q is between S and R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79efe044c6c117507c9e51b78873ef315b11dc7a867f76b8fb8c051b32c4c784.png] 

4) Only one position are left for U

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4fe7415bfba5d63d7cd19da12b1343f7875192804528c0bd1eb5edda965c5d3.png] 

Clearly, we can see that **U **is sitting at the left end.

Hence, the correct answer is **"U".**
